news.title: Bitcoin steadies above $79,000 as ETF inflows hit longest streak since April
news.summary: BTC held its ground Thursday as spot bitcoin ETFs logged an eighth straight day of net inflows, while altcoins drifted lower across the board.

news.title: Bitfinex Securities raises $50 million in push to offer tokenized nickel trading
news.summary: Bitfinex Securities is preparing to list a new security linked to a Luxembourg-based industrial metals platform built around a $1.6 billion stockpile of high-purity nickel wire.

news.title: BlackRock's Mitchnick says macro case for bitcoin is strengthening after record trading in positive week
news.summary: BlackRock's head of digital assets shared his outlook for bitcoin after the company's spot BTC ETF, IBIT, hit record volume for a positive week.

news.title: Nvidia shares surge 8% on earnings beat, lifting technology stocks and bitcoin
news.summary: Nvidia’s earnings beat and strong outlook lifted technology stocks, bitcoin and AI infrastructure companies.

news.title: Britain plans new Bank of England objective for stablecoins
news.summary: Financial stability would remain its primary duty, with annual reports to Parliament on the new objective being planned.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin tops $80,000 as ETF inflows hit eight straight days
news.summary: U.S. spot bitcoin funds have taken in $2.8 billion since the run began, and ether ETFs are matching it day for day. Three sessions are left to make August their best month since October 2025.

news.title: Bitcoin researchers propose quantum fix that would not crowd out transactions
news.summary: The SHRINCS proposal would let bitcoin transactions use larger, quantum-resistant approvals while preserving more network capacity than existing post-quantum signature designs.

news.title: Binance co-founders CZ and Yi He adopted Simpsons cartoon aliases ‘Homer’ and ‘Marge’ in company meetings
news.summary: Yi, who is now the co-CEO of Binance alongside its other chief Richard Teng, still uses the name Marge in meetings and chats.

news.title: Nvidia stock is climbing after another set of blockbuster results. Here’s what Wall Street is saying.
news.summary: Shares of Nvidia rose in premarket trading on Thursday. Goldman Sachs and Citigroup raised their price targets for the stock.

news.title: Second straight rate hike for Asia’s number-three economy as Nvidia-led AI expansion continues
news.summary: The Bank of Korea tightened monetary policy by 25 basis points to 3% Thursday while simultaneously raising growth forecasts. Asia’s third-largest economy is being powered by an AI boom that Nvidia’s second-quarter results confirmed is far from being over.

news.title: My mother, 91, has dementia. Every bank says I need her signature to unlock her $100,000 stock certificate. What can I do?
news.summary: “These shares are the only assets in her estate without designated beneficiaries.”

news.title: Ozempic maker Novo Nordisk downgraded to sell after 70% stock-price dive from peak
news.summary: While Ozempic maker Novo Nordisk has fallen on tough times, Wall Street analysts have still been reluctant to advise investors to sell the stock, until Deutsche Bank lowered the boom on Thursday.

news.title: What to know about Hugging Face, the open-source AI startup reportedly catching Nvidia’s eye
news.summary: New reports outline deal talks between the two companies as open-source AI technology comes more into focus.

news.title: ‘My main goal is to help people’: I’m single, 74, with $10 million burning a hole in my pocket. What should I do?
news.summary: “I also own my home and an SUV outright, with no outstanding debt.”

news.title: CrowdStrike’s stock soars after AI fuels the cybersecurity company’s ‘best quarter in history’
news.summary: Shares of CrowdStrike Holdings were roaring after the cybersecurity company revealed a record-breaking quarter, one partially boosted by fears about the power of artificial intelligence.
